Blossom (Japanese: シオネ Shione) is a from the Laverre Gym. In , she is a recurring character who first appeared in A Fashionable Battle!.

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
Blossom is a loyal to Laverre City Gym Leader Valerie. She and another Furisode Girl, , were first seen spying on and when they were looking through Valerie's fashion collection. They thought they would be perfect to participate in a fashion show of Valerie's collection and asked them to come with them.

Blossom reappeared in Fairy-Type Trickery!, where she was following and Valerie's Gym .

She reappeared in a flashback in Till We Compete Again!.

====Voice actors====
 

==In the core series games==
Blossom appears in Pokémon X and Y as one of the s in the Laverre Gym.

===Pokémon===
 
 
 
 
 
==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Masters EX===
 
Blossom forms a sync pair with in Pokémon Masters EX. Blossom became a playable sync pair on January 3, 2025.
